name: T-reserve-availability (DB)
description: Reserve refuses when qty exceeds free (on_hand-reserved-held) counting SO soft and hard claims; exact-to-free succeeds; two concurrent reserves of last units: one wins, one typed refusal; serialized unit claimed by SO or project or not in_stock refused; FIFO reserve of N fails whole when fewer than N free

name: T-shared-counter (DB)
description: After project reserve, SO allocateLine, queryProductAvailability and consume guard all see less free stock; staging moves claim reserved to held and consume then refuses even with the override

name: T-reconcile (DB)
description: Rebuild stock caches preserves project reserved and held claims and clears drift; written to fail before the change

name: T-poach (DB)
description: SO fulfillment never picks a project-claimed unit by FIFO or explicit pick; picker shows it not selectable; non-serialized warn-only behaviour documented

name: T-install (DB)
description: Install consumes once at the claim location, releases claim, creates one project_materials row with planned billing fields; serialized delivers claimed unit and creates asset after commit; undo restores hard claim; deleting material releases line

name: T-no-side-effects (DB)
description: Rendering box labels, mixed bulk labels and manifests leaves row counts and checksums unchanged for stock_levels, stock_movements, stock_units, project_materials, project_staging_lines, staging_*, invoices, invoice_charges, documents, time entries, assets; only SELECT statements issued; no events published

name: T-reserve-is-not-consume (DB)
description: Reserve, stage and pack write no stock_movements and no project_materials; billing run preview shows no charge for staged lines

name: T-client-items (DB)
description: Client lines never create stock_units, movements or levels, never billable; client_asset of another client refused

name: T-boxes (DB)
description: Member quantity sums <= line quantity; serialized/client-asset line in at most one box; sealed box refuses changes; delete only when empty; n of m correct after deletions; packing stages the line

name: T-authz
description: Missing and forbidden box in label and manifest requests both 404 identically; no record-level project read gets nothing; mutations need project:update plus record check

name: T-labels
description: Mixed-item printLabels keeps order and all-or-nothing; recordLinks round-trips staging_container; mobile parity test passes; sequence binding renders n of m

name: T-sales-order-unchanged
description: alloc.db.test.ts, flows.db.test.ts, salesOrderGuards.db.test.ts pass unmodified after the allocation.ts extraction

name: T-migration (DB)
description: Migrations apply on a clean schema; CHECK blocks a unit with both allocated_so_line_id and allocated_staging_line_id; serialized staging line quantity must be 1
